scope: Mathematical validation of the existing pinned vLLM MXFP8 implementation; no new kernel or speedup measurement.

input_recipe.source: Seeded FP32 Gaussian, scaled by per-row/per-32-block powers of two, rounded to BF16, then vLLM MXFP8 quantization.
input_recipe.reference_operands: Quantized E4M3 values multiplied by decoded per-32 E8M0 scales in float64.
